sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding a five-game winning streak, welcome Alsager Town to their home ground on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Alsager are in relegation form at the bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches and have lost their last five games, making this a straightforward fixture for the league leaders.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second place with 20 points, travel away to Dawley Town and will be keen to keep pace with Sandbach; Stafford have drawn their most recent fixture and are two points behind. AFC Bridgnorth, third on 19 points, host Eccleshall (currently fifth) in a direct mid-table encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, welcome Wednesfield Community in a local derby-style fixture. Bilston Town, sixth on 17 points, travel to Foley Meir (11th place) in a clash between mid-table sides. Barnton, seventh with 15 points, visit Shawbury United, who are in desperate form with five consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town, 10th place, host New Mills (eighth) in a mid-table affair. Crewe, sitting 16th, face Allscott Heath (11th) in a lower-half battle, while Brereton Social (14th) travel to face Widnes Town (bottom, with just 2 points from 7 games and winless in their last six). Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th) complete the fixture list away at Telford Town (18th) in a match between the division's lowest-ranked sides.
